title: The Balancing Act #247 (Andrew Temte) — 'corporate corruption is not primarily ethical — it is structural'
summary: Andrew Temte runs Eric on The Balancing Act #247, framing Incorruptible's central reframe — that the corruption of great companies is a design problem, not an ethics problem — for an executive and capital-markets audience.
blockquote: What if the corruption of great companies isn't an ethics problem at all — but a design problem?
